reason: I have one apartment next to our house, and when guests have a question I'm right there or I answer on my phone at lunch. Booking and Airbnb already send my Wi-Fi and check-in messages for free, so €120 a season is money I'd rather keep.
objection: It solves a problem I don't really have with one unit. My guests already get automatic messages from Booking and Airbnb, and anything they still ask me takes two minutes on WhatsApp.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or almost free for one small apartment, or a neighbour I trust used it and told me it brought better reviews or saved her real time.
